corridor-x-dimitrovgrad-bypass-serbia.card_says: "Public Enterprise Roads of Serbia" / "The state road enterprise, named in the completion report as PEPS and in the evaluation as PERS" - present tense, public-enterprise legal form.
corridor-x-dimitrovgrad-bypass-serbia.source_says: On 22 December 2025 Serbia's government adopted a decision, published in the Official Gazette under the Law on managing companies owned by the Republic of Serbia, changing the legal status of seven public enterprises to limited companies; Putevi Srbije (Roads of Serbia) is named among them. The enterprise itself was created by Government Decision 05 no. 023/8228/2005 of 22 December 2005, in force 1 January 2006, and still files accounts: operating revenue RSD 61.9 billion and a net loss of about RSD 22 billion (EUR 194 million) for 2025.

source.title: Seven Public Enterprises Becoming Limited Companies

source_2.title: Gubitak Puteva Srbije u 2025. skoro 200 miliona evra, a jos toliko duguju dobavljacima

corridor-x-dimitrovgrad-bypass-serbia.card_says: "The state company that ran the works as the project implementation entity" - present tense, implying a continuing separate company.
corridor-x-dimitrovgrad-bypass-serbia.source_says: UNRESOLVED, not a correction. A trade report states that the ministry "has approved a merger between the public-owned roads companies Putevi Srbije (Roads of Serbia)" and Koridori Srbije, and that "Putevi Srbije maintains roads while Koridori focuses on construction planning and project management". The article carries no date on the page (an internal citation points to a 2013 source) and does not say which entity survives, so it cannot be used to say the company was merged out of existence; later Serbian coverage still names Koridori Srbije as the motorway investor. Flagged for someone with access to the Serbian business register (APR).

source.title: Serbia approves merger Koridori Srbije and Putevi Srbije

milot-rreshen-road-compensation-albania.card_says: "The Albanian road agency that implemented the project through its Project Implementation Team..." and, in the present tense, "it committed to developing a plan to protect its right of way".
milot-rreshen-road-compensation-albania.source_says: Albania's supreme audit institution writes "Drejtoria e Pergjithshme e Rrugeve (sot Autoriteti Rrugor Shqiptar)" - the General Roads Directorate is today the Albanian Road Authority - and audits the body under Law no. 10164 of 15 October 2009 "On the Albanian Road Authority". The report does not give the date of the change; it notes that contracts from 2009 onward were signed by the former directorate. The body the card describes therefore no longer carries that name.

source.title: Mbi Auditimin e Ushtruar ne Autoritetin Rrugor Shqiptar (final audit report, Decision no. 13 of the KLSH Chairman)
source.publisher: Kontrolli i Larte i Shtetit (Supreme State Audit, Albania)

ethiopia-sudan-interconnector-line-death.card_says: "The Ethiopian state electricity utility, which was the project's implementing agency" - the body is described in the present tense as the state utility.
ethiopia-sudan-interconnector-line-death.source_says: EEPCo ceased to exist as a single body in mid-December 2013, when a "major reshuffle in policy saw the split in two independent entities" of the state-run monopoly: Ethiopian Electric Power, which "is tasked to undertake and oversee the country's power projects" including dams and transmission lines, and a separate service company responsible for operations, distribution and sales. A 2013 Council of Ministers regulation establishing Ethiopian Electric Power was issued under Proclamation No. 691/2010 and the Public Enterprises Proclamation No. 25/1992.

source.title: Will Ethiopia sort out its energy puzzle?

source_2.title: Ethiopian Electric Power Establishment Council of Ministers Regulation (entry)

ethiopia-sudan-interconnector-line-death.source_says: INTERNAL TO THE SAME DOCUMENT, not an outside conflict. Paragraph 56 of the completion report calls Energoinvest "the subcontractor for the transmission line", but the report's contract annex states that "A turn-key contract was awarded to Energoinvest of Bosnia & Herzegovina for the construction of 230 kV transmission lines", signed 18 December 2008, covering Bahir Dar-Gonder (138 km), Gonder-Shehedi (122 km) and Shehedi-Metema (37 km). On the annex's wording it held the main works contract, not a subcontract. The annex is also the only place that fixes the firm's nationality, which is what allowed it to be described at all.

source.title: Implementation Completion and Results Report, Ethiopia-Sudan Power Systems Interconnection Project (P074011), para. 56 and contract annex

newmap-nigeria-erosion-displacement.company: Federal Ministry of Environment, National Project Implementation Unit
newmap-nigeria-erosion-displacement.card_says: The national unit is called the "National Project Implementation Unit".
newmap-nigeria-erosion-displacement.source_says: The ministry's own updated Resettlement Policy Framework for the project calls the national body the "Federal Project Management Unit" (FPMU) throughout, on the cover as "NEWMAP - FPMU", and says the "Federal Ministry of Environment established Federal Project Management Unit" to "continue to provide technical support to new and existing State PMUs", to ensure implementation of the framework and resettlement plans, and to handle "overall monitoring & evaluation and reporting of project performance to the World Bank". The document uses neither "National Project Management Unit" nor "National Project Implementation Unit".

source.title: Updated NEWMAP Resettlement Policy Framework
source.publisher: Federal Ministry of Environment, Nigeria (Erosion and Watershed Management Department)

nepal-raidp-land-donation.company: Department of Local Infrastructure Development and Agricultural Roads (DOLIDAR)
nepal-raidp-land-donation.card_says: "The department of Nepal's local development ministry responsible for rural infrastructure and agricultural roads" - present tense, under a local development ministry.
nepal-raidp-land-donation.source_says: The department's current official site publishes as "Department of Local Infrastructure (DoLI)" under the "Ministry of Urban Development", with Local Infrastructure Development Program Offices (LIDPO) beneath it in each province; its own older pages use "DoLIDAR" and "DoLI" interchangeably. No page opened states when, or by what instrument, DOLIDAR became DoLI, or that the ministry it sits under changed, so the change is recorded here rather than asserted. A 2018 review of local road maintenance in federal Nepal says DoLIDAR was created in the 1990s and worked through district offices, and that central agencies' executive functions were expected to pass to the provinces.

source.title: Department of Local Infrastructure (DoLI), Bagmati - Local Infrastructure Development Program Office
source.publisher: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Urban Development

source_2.title: Policy brief: maintenance planning in federal Nepal

shangrao-sanqingshan-airport-land-take.card_says: "The provincial airport operator, which runs all seven airports in Jiangxi."
shangrao-sanqingshan-airport-land-take.source_says: UNCONFIRMED rather than contradicted. The most recent state-media report naming the group's airports lists six - Nanchang, Jingdezhen, Shangrao, Ruijin, Ganzhou and Yichun - and gives no total count, so nothing opened supports "all seven". The same report gives 2,849 flights and 389,000 passengers handled by the group over the 1-7 October 2026 holiday.

source.title: Guoqing jiaqi Jiangxi jichang jituan yingsong lvke 38.9 wan renci

patna-ganga-riverfront-resettlement.card_says: "The mission under the Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation in India's Ministry of Jal Shakti that implemented the project."
patna-ganga-riverfront-resettlement.source_says: NOT SUPPORTED by the instrument, rather than contradicted. The River Ganga (Rejuvenation, Protection and Management) Authorities Order of 10 July 2016 constitutes NMCG as a society registered under the Societies Registration Act 1860 and an authority under the Act, with a governing council and executive committee and a Director General appointed by the central government. It does not place the Mission under that Department: the Department appears only as the source of a Joint Secretary on the governing council, and "Ministry of Jal Shakti" appears only as the publishing heading. On the standing rule that "X sits under Y" needs a page saying so, the card's ministry line needs a separate source (an allocation-of-business rule or the Mission's own memorandum).

source.title: River Ganga (Rejuvenation, Protection and Management) Authorities Order, 2016, ss. 31-47
